scope: Jurisdiction-level VAT refund guidance for foreign travelers only; this does not establish Longines retailer participation, an individual purchaser's eligibility, or a guaranteed refund amount.
purpose: 新增 Longines 台灣市場時的旅客退稅政策查核。data/traveler-refund-policies.json 已有 TW 市場級記錄（evidencePath 指向 data/evidence/rolex/TW/2026-09-11/traveler-refund-policy.json）；本次重新開啟同一官方來源確認制度仍存在且與既有摘要一致，未修改正式政策記錄。

sources.title: VAT Refund Guidelines for Foreign Travelers

observedFacts: Foreign travelers who enter with the listed non-ROC-ID documents and stay no more than 183 days from arrival are covered.
Purchases must total at least NT$2,000 on the same day from the same designated store displaying the 'Taiwan Tax Refund' label.
Tax refund applications must be completed before the goods are taken out of the country for the first time; applications not approved by Customs before departure cannot be processed afterward.
comparisonWithExistingRecord: 與既有 TW 記錄的 availability=available、merchantParticipationRequired=true、exportValidationRequired=true 及資格摘要一致；無需更新。
method: WebFetch 讀取官方頁面摘要式內容（非逐字全文保存）。
limitations: Longines retailer participation in the Taiwan Tax Refund scheme is not established by this evidence.
No exact transaction-specific refund amount is represented in the comparison.
